TOOLING BURST T4k — burst_v2 lap 3: un-clip the stretched tongues and kill the dark ring (Run C-5; conductor findings F-C5-6 / F-C5-7 from the outside bake of your T4j build, R-C5-29). task_id "T4k".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a (material), T4h with its lap-2 clause.
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (the piece_burst_v2 emission — your T4j code; the `outer_distance` per-piece clip and the whole-body distance sampling; the dark-duplicate root/paint sprites), export/vfx_material.gdshader (distance_texture sampled at UV with repeat_disable; erode / outer_distance / dissolve), export/effect_kit.py (dissolve_order), runs/C-5/t3/T4j/README.md + acceptance.json, and the conductor's rendered evidence: runs/C-5/t3/T4j/bake_rows_outside.json (extent plateaus at exactly 511 px from frame 8; largest-component 0.956 at f20; residue 12.7 %) and runs/C-5/t3/T4j/burst_v2l2_contact.png (frames 8–20: every long tongue ends in a STRAIGHT hard cut; frame 30: a black ring around the eroding core). tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import proofs only (rendered bakes SIGABRT in your sandbox — the conductor bakes outside).

DIAGNOSE FIRST (write runs/C-5/t3/T4k/diagnosis.json): (F-C5-6) a stretched tongue's far pixels map to UV outside [0,1] of the ORIGINAL 512 canvas; with repeat_disable the whole-body distance sample clamps to the edge value, and either the `outer_distance` clip or the erode threshold then discards them — hence the straight cut exactly at the canvas boundary. State which rule cuts, with the numbers. (F-C5-7) the dark ring at frame 30: determine whether it is (a) band 0 of the body surviving the [1,0] dissolve group, (b) the DARK DUPLICATE layer (MIX black beneath the body) eroding on a different schedule/threshold than the body sprites, or (c) the PeakDark hold sprite — by reading the emitted node tree and each sprite's erode/dissolve uniforms at age 30 in a headless trace.

BUILD (minimal; legacy six kits + burst_v1 byte-identical; v2 lap-2 behaviour otherwise unchanged): (1) make the distance/erosion sampling STRETCH-AWARE for v2 pieces — sample the whole-body distance field through the piece's ORIGINAL (unstretched) pixel coordinates, i.e. pass the stretch transform into the shader (or pre-compute per piece a distance texture in the piece's own UV space padded so the stretched sprite never leaves [0,1]) so no pixel is discarded for lying beyond the source canvas; drop or rescale the `outer_distance` clip during expansion so it only bounds the RESIDUE phase; (2) make every layer of a piece (body sprite, dark duplicate, halo if per-piece) erode and dissolve on the SAME schedule and thresholds — one set of uniforms driven per piece and applied to all its sprites — so nothing dark survives the body; keep dissolve_order semantics; (3) residue target: the residue phase must hold 15–25 % of peak coverage (T4j gave 12.7 %) — tune the residue threshold, not the scaling.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): a headless clock trace asserting, at expansion ticks, that no v2 piece pixel is discarded by the canvas boundary (a CPU re-implementation of the sampling on the T4e-r1 pieces at 3× stretch: coverage of the stretched piece ≥ 95 % of its analytic stretched coverage); a trace at age 30 asserting every sprite under a piece shares the piece's erode/dissolve values; dissolve_order legacy default unchanged (hash table for the six kits + v1).
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4k/acceptance.json; rendered = conductor's): CPU stretched-coverage ≥ 95 % with no boundary discard; per-piece layer uniform equality; residue prediction within 15–25 %; legacy byte-identity; headless import exit 0; in-sandbox suite reds named (five standing + env).

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any test file except the two named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4k/ and runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4k/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4k"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
